tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels: work queue, case workspace, customer pages. Text on it: ink, ink-secondary, ink-muted, brand-600.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, dialogs, drawers, inputs. The default ground for every component.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table header rows, panel sub-headers and read-only wells (sample values, provenance blocks).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, skeleton loaders, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on table rows, list items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row, current review item, active filter chip and active work-queue bucket.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Top bar and the login brand panel. Text on it: on-inverse, on-inverse-muted.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: Active top-bar item, the sealed ACTIVE pill and the snapshot seal panel. Text on it: on-inverse (13.9:1).

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row separators and panel borders. Decorative hairlines only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Section dividers inside panels, the table header rule, non-interactive card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios and secondary buttons (3.1:1 on surface). Dashed, it marks an unconfirmed LLM proposal.

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Dividers on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-muted, canvas, brand-50 and every status *-bg tint (15:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and cell meta on surface, surface-muted, canvas and neutral-bg (8.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, placeholders and column headers on surface, surface-muted, surface-sunken, canvas, brand-50 and status tints (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text only. Never carries information; a disabled action always shows its reason in ink-muted beside it.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse and surface-inverse-raised.

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (8.1:1) and surface-inverse-raised (7:1).

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Selection tint and the progress pill ground. Ink and brand-700 read on it.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Hover on selected rows; the tint block on the cover.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Progress pill border and the connector between completed Smart Parser stages.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Graphic marks only: the running-stage arc and the stage strip fill (4.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Links and interactive text on surface, canvas, surface-muted and brand-50 (6.2:1 or more). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Primary button fill with on-brand text (9.4:1); progress pill text on brand-50 (8.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-800
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-700 and brand-800 fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset in the ground colour. 3:1 or more on surface, canvas and brand-50.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of success pills and notices: VALIDATED, PASS, CLEAN, mapped.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of success pills and notices.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and glyphs on success-bg (6.3:1) and surface (7.2:1).

tokens.name: success-mark
tokens.usage: PASS segment in result bars. Label inside it in ink. Lighter than danger-mark by 3.4:1 so PASS and FAIL differ in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of attention pills and notices: REVIEW_REQUIRED, RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED, warnings, MEDIUM severity.

tokens.name: attention-line
tokens.usage: Border of attention pills and notices.

tokens.name: attention-fg
tokens.usage: Attention text and glyphs on attention-bg (6.5:1) and surface (7.2:1).

tokens.name: attention-mark
tokens.usage: Attention segments and the sign-sensitive marker in graphics. Label inside it in ink (6.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of blocking pills and notices: FAILED_VALIDATION, FAIL, failed runs and files, HIGH severity, EXCEPTIONS_OPEN.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of danger pills and notices.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger text and glyphs on danger-bg (6.5:1) and surface (7.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-mark
tokens.usage: FAIL segment in result bars. Label inside it in white (7.7:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-mark
tokens.usage: Labels inside danger-mark segments and other dark data fills (7.7:1 on danger-mark).

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral pills: awaiting, not applicable, LOW severity, superseded versions.

tokens.name: neutral-line
tokens.usage: Border of neutral pills.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral pill text and glyphs on neutral-bg (6.8:1) and surface (7.8:1).

tokens.name: neutral-mark
tokens.usage: NOT_APPLICABLE segment in result bars. Label inside it in ink (10.5:1).

tokens.name: sealed-bg
tokens.usage: ACTIVE (sealed) pill ground and the snapshot seal. Text on it: sealed-fg.

tokens.name: sealed-fg
tokens.usage: Text and lock glyph on sealed-bg (15.8:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the activation confirmation.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Login headline and empty-state headlines only. Never inside data views.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: the case header (customer and period) or the screen title.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Sub-panel headings, table group headers and inspector sections.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text, explanations and form values.
styles.sample: Smart Parser compares each source header with the canonical schema.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary cell values (customer, file name) and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.usage: Dense tables (mapping review, exceptions, inventory) and inspector content.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, pill text and keys in key-value lists.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text and second lines inside table cells.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sparing uppercase overlines (stage numbers, panel eyebrows). Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Stat values (counts, totals) in proportional figures. At most one row of figures per view.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers, source headers, canonical field names and enum values.

styles.name: mono-dense
styles.usage: SHA-256 hashes, archive paths and event-log lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell padding block in dense tables.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding inline; gap between pills and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters and the gap between main and aside columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section separation on long pages; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Login panel padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, enum chips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, filter chips, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, drop zones, notices.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popover menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars only.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, comboboxes and the profile popover. Panels never cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Right-hand drawers (file detail, exception detail).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Login form and dialog commit buttons.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Dense table rows (mapping review, exceptions, event log).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Default table rows with a second caption line (work queue, inventory).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Global top bar.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Mapping-review inspector and other docked detail panels.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand drawers.
